column1: # Compile-only probes of the 3502 function-coercion rule after Epic's answers to followup-coerce (#724): a function value that is no function named where its type is expected (a result, a field, a call's result, an array, a map, a tuple's element, an argument of a generic call), int/rational and void results, class variance of values, a parametric class's method at any. Each header and note give OpenVerse's verdict (Lean and C agreeing) and what either answer changes; epic_outcome and epic_lines: - until compiled by UEFN 43.12 (++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086).

column7: OpenVerse: ran, true branch 3|false branch 3. Refused: int to rational needs a wrapper in a join; drop the exemption. Admitted: as implemented.
OpenVerse: ran, value 2. Admitted expected. Refused: method values are no names to a generic call.
OpenVerse: ran, value 3. Admitted expected. Refused: names get no int/rational wrapper.
OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_(:int):void}, found type{_(:int):int}. Control: admitted expected; openverse refuses it, an existing gap (int->int is no int->void value in openverse).
OpenVerse: ran, took. Admitted expected. Refused: drop the any exemption.

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: as implemented. Admitted: a generic call converts its arguments as names.

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type []type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type []type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: as implemented (containers of function values). Admitted: arrays convert their elements as names; exempt arrays.
OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: as implemented. Admitted: call results are exempt.
OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_():animal}, found type{_():dog}. Admitted expected: openverse refuses a valid program, as value-class-variance (a recorded difference).

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: fields are values. Admitted: a field read is named as a function is; exempt fields.

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: an archetype's field value is converted as a value. Admitted: exempt archetype fields.

OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_(:int):rational}, found type{_(:int):int}. Refused 3502: int to rational needs a wrapper; drop the int/rational exemption of joins. Admitted: openverse refuses a valid program.
OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type [int]type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type [int]type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: as implemented. Admitted: exempt maps.

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type type{_(:int)<computes>:int} as a value of type type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}. Refused: the rule covers a function's result. Admitted: a returned value is converted as a name is; exempt returns.

OpenVerse: refused, 3502 rule: using a value of type tuple(type{_(:int)<computes>:int}, int) as a value of type tuple(type{_(:int)<transacts>:int}, int). Refused: as implemented. Admitted: a tuple's elements are converted as names; exempt them.
OpenVerse: refused, expected type{_(:int):void}, found type{_(:int):int}. Refused 3502: a result discarded needs a wrapper. Admitted: openverse refuses a valid program.
